stories.task_name: [QA] - Editing existing PDF text (move, resize, edit, delete)
instructions: Every case uploads one of the fixtures in tests/OverlayEditor as a fresh disposable document and opens it at edit-new?pdfjs=1 with Edit PDF on (the premium gate is bypassed by rewriting data-editor-authenticated in the page response)
Only the document's own text is acted on with the annotation menu (move grip, Edit, Delete) and the right resize handle -- no Add Text, Shapes, Highlight, Draw, Sign or Image

EVERY CASE HAS TWO COMPONENTS AND BOTH MUST PASS: A (items prefixed A:) checks the editor and records what it showed; B (items prefixed B:) downloads through the editor's own Download PDF path, reads the PDF back with PyMuPDF (inspect_pdf.py) and compares it against what A recorded and against the untouched baseline download of the same document

Fonts are judged by family root: the embedded face, a bundled face of the same family, or the substitute config/font_substitutes.json maps it to; a single-span title may be fitted down by at most 10% to its source line (contract rule 7)
Needs node with playwright and a python with PyMuPDF (PYTHON_BIN, the repo .venv, or python3); extraction runs through Horizon, so a case waits for its boxes to be promoted before acting

tests.title: Setup: each fixture uploads, extracts and opens with its text promoted; the untouched download is the baseline
tests.summary: Precondition for the whole story: each fixture in tests/OverlayEditor uploads as a disposable document, extraction promotes its text into source boxes, Edit PDF turns on and the console stays clean. B downloads each untouched document and proves it equals the fixture page for page -- the baseline every later case compares against.

tests.title: Selecting existing text makes a source box on the glyph bounds; entering Edit changes nothing
tests.summary: Clicking existing text selects a source box (not a user text box) sitting on the glyph bounds with the fixture span's family and size captured. Entering Edit changes no size, moves nothing and creates no moved-source mask; Escape leaves the text alone. B: the download is identical to the baseline.

tests.title: Untouched text is untouched: Edit on and off, save, download equals the baseline
tests.summary: Edit PDF on, off, Save: the save payload carries no changed, moved, deleted or user rows and no box is marked as an overlay. B: every page is byte-identical to the baseline and no promoted row was exported.

tests.title: Move a single-line row: one solid mask equal to the source bbox, text keeps font, size and colour
tests.summary: Drag the invoice number row down with the annotation menu grip. A: the box becomes a moved overlay by the pointer distance in PDF points, keeps family, size and words, and one solid mask sits on the immutable source bbox within 0.25px. B: the string is found once where A put it, in A's family and size, the old bbox returns zero hits and reads as background, the rest of the page extracts unchanged.

tests.title: Move a multi-line paragraph: lines and runs travel with it, neighbours untouched
tests.summary: Drag the drylab welcome paragraph down. A: every line and run travels with it, one mask covers every source line, the title and strapline are untouched. B: the paragraph's lines extract at the new place with A's line breaks in Lato at 12pt, the old area is scrubbed, everything outside is identical.

tests.title: Move text out of a filled form cell: the mask repaints the cell dark, the text stays white
tests.summary: Drag the white 'Part I' out of its black cell along the band. A: the mask repaints the cell in its own dark colour with no white hole and the moved text keeps its white colour. B: the cell is still dark with the light glyphs gone, 'Part I' is found white at A's position in the source family or its configured substitute.

tests.title: Move text between tight rows: the mask stays inside its bbox, rules and neighbours intact
tests.summary: Drag line 1 of Schedule 1 right between tight rows. A: the mask stays inside the row's bbox and the old place shows no glyph ink; the neighbours are not moved, restyled or masked. B: the row is at A's position, adjacent rows are at their own bboxes, the ruling lines through the band are all still drawn.

tests.title: Moved text in the download: old place scrubbed, found at the new place, rest unchanged
tests.summary: The moved-text contract on the invoice 'Subtotal': A records the moved text, its new box in PDF points and the mask rectangle. B: the old bbox has zero search hits and reads as background, the string sits at A's new bbox in the same face and size, every other span extracts unchanged.

tests.title: Resize a paragraph: reflow at the same size, the download reflows the same way
tests.summary: Drag the paragraph's right edge in. A: the text reflows into more lines at the same font size with every word kept; dragging back restores the original breaks. B: the download reflows exactly as the editor did at the narrow width, and after resizing back it breaks its lines where the editor does.

tests.title: Resize a single-line title narrower: the type is not scaled, the export matches
tests.summary: Resize the invoice's 'Organic Items' header narrower than its text. A: the font size is not scaled and the overflow wraps rather than shrinking the type. B: the download lays the title out exactly as A showed, in the same bold face and size, with the rest of the page identical.

tests.title: Edit a single-span title: exact source-line fitting in the original weight
tests.summary: Change 'DrylabNews' to 'DrylabNotes'. A: only that run changes, the box does not move, the size and family are kept. B: the replacement is found in the original bbox in Montserrat 700 (or its substitute), fitted down by at most 10% to the source line, 'DrylabNews' is gone, no missing-glyph boxes.

tests.title: Edit a word inside a paragraph: runs and breaks kept, export matches
tests.summary: Change 'promise' to 'pledge' mid-paragraph. A: only that word changes, the line breaks and box geometry are kept. B: the paragraph extracts with exactly A's lines, 'promise' returns zero hits at the box, and the paragraph is in Lato at 12pt.

tests.title: Replacement text comes only from the saved annotation
tests.summary: Edit the invoice number then Save. A: the saved annotation text in the save payload equals what the box displays. B: the download extracts the saved text character for character and the original string has zero hits anywhere on the page.

tests.title: No boxes, close font: original family or its substitute at the original size and weight
tests.summary: Edit a HelveticaNeue row on f1040s1 and the Montserrat title on drylab. A: the browser draws each replacement in a real face at the source size with no missing-glyph box. B: each replacement uses the source family or its configured substitute (config/font_substitutes.json) at the source size and weight, no U+FFFD, ink coverage in the text range rather than a solid block.

tests.title: Edit on a form: substitution keeps size and weight, white-on-black renders, widgets untouched
tests.summary: Edit the FranklinGothic heading and the white 'Part I' on f1040s1. A: boxes keep position and size, 'Part I' stays white, the form widgets are still rendered. B: the replacements are found at their boxes in the family or substitute at the same size and weight, 'Part X' is white on the still-black cell, all widgets and their values are unchanged.

tests.title: Special glyphs survive an edit of the neighbouring text (Isartor)
tests.summary: Edit the Verdana 'Version 1.0' line on Isartor. A: every other page-1 box keeps its place and face. B: 'Version 1.1' is at A's box in Verdana bold, the Symbol font is still on the page, every Symbol-font span outside the edited line keeps its characters and bbox, pages 2-20 are byte-identical.

tests.title: Delete is scrubbed: zero hits, absent from extraction, gone after reload
tests.summary: Delete the 'Watermelon' row, save, reload. A: the row disappears with no white box painted and does not re-spawn after reload. B: the deleted text has zero search hits and is absent from get_text(), the region reads as background, the neighbouring rows are still at their bboxes.

tests.title: Delete on a form leaves the artwork and the widgets
tests.summary: Delete line 3 inside the f1040s1 grid. A: no white rectangle, the neighbours keep their text and place. B: the row's text has zero hits, the ruling lines through the band all still draw (fill-less redaction), no white-box artifact where the row's rule runs, the widgets are unchanged.

tests.title: Delete one row of a tight stack; the rows above and below stay
tests.summary: Delete line 2a, the middle of three tight rows. A: only it goes, the rows above and below keep text and position. B: the middle row has zero hits, the rows above and below extract at their own bboxes with the band's rules intact.

tests.title: Delete a sentence inside a paragraph; the rest keeps its layout
tests.summary: Delete one sentence from the middle of the drylab paragraph. A: the sentence is gone, the rest is kept, the font size and box are unchanged. B: the deleted sentence returns zero hits, the paragraph extracts with exactly A's lines in Lato at 12pt.

tests.title: The background is untouched on a download
tests.summary: Move the invoice total and record the touched bbox. B: every span outside it extracts identically to the baseline, images, widgets and embedded faces are all still there, and strips away from the box have the baseline's dark-pixel ratio within 0.01.

tests.title: Only affected pages are redrawn (drylab, Isartor)
tests.summary: One edit on page 1 of drylab and of Isartor. B: every other page is byte-identical to the baseline (content and text hashes), page 1 did change, and it changed only inside the edited bbox.

tests.title: Move, resize, edit and delete survive save and reload, and download the same
tests.summary: A move, a resize, an edit and a delete, then Save and reload. A: each box comes back with the same geometry and text, the deleted row stays gone, the moved row's mask is still at the source bbox. B: the download after the reload matches the one before it.

tests.title: Undo and redo restore each state; the download after undo equals the baseline
tests.summary: Move, resize, edit, delete, then Undo until the stack empties and Redo until it refills. A: each original state is restored with no mask left behind, then every operation is re-applied. B: after the undos the download equals the baseline; after the redos it equals the download taken before the undos.

tests.title: Zoom: geometry and masks hold at 50%, 100% and 190%; downloads are identical
tests.summary: After a move and an edit, step to the lowest zoom, about 100% and back to the highest. A: PDF-point geometry is unchanged at every level, the moved mask still equals the source bbox at that scale, the replacement stays in its box. B: the downloads at the lowest and highest zoom are identical and match A's geometry.
